evidence.title: Raleigh Executive Jetport

evidence.title: Raleigh Executive Jetport
evidence.text: It is owned by the Sanford-Lee County Regional Airport Authority and was previously known as Sanford-Lee County Regional Airport.

evidence.title: Raleigh Executive Jetport
evidence.text: This airport is included in the National Plan of Integrated Airport Systems for 2011–2015, which categorized it as a "reliever airport" for Raleigh-Durham International Airport.

evidence.title: Elizabeth City Regional Airport
evidence.text: Elizabeth City Regional Airport (IATA: ECG, ICAO: KECG, FAA LID: ECG) is a joint civil-military public and military use airport located three nautical miles (6 km) southeast of the central business district of Elizabeth City, in Pasquotank County, North Carolina, United States.

evidence.title: Elizabeth City Regional Airport
evidence.text: The airport, on the shore of the Pasquotank River, is also known as Elizabeth City-Pasquotank County Regional Airport or ECG Regional Airport.

evidence.title: Elizabeth City Regional Airport
evidence.text: It is included in the National Plan of Integrated Airport Systems for 2011–2015, which categorized it as a "general aviation" facility.

evidence.title: Susquehanna Area Regional Airport Authority
evidence.text: The Susquehanna Area Regional Airport Authority (SARAA) is the governing authority of Harrisburg International Airport, Capital City Airport, Franklin County Regional Airport and Gettysburg Regional Airport in south-central Pennsylvania.

evidence.title: Susquehanna Area Regional Airport Authority
evidence.text: SARAA was incorporated on September 9, 1997, and officially took over control of HIA and CXY airports from the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania on January 1, 1998.
